AUDIT QUESTION: Batched audit (orchestrator note 05:40 ET) of two commits. (1) Phase 2: the 9:16 is a per-shot speaker-centred reframe measured with SCRFD (vertical_layout.classify; screen / single / stack2 / stack3 / uncertain by fixed face-area rules), safe frame (whole 16:9) only for screen/uncertain and flagged; new gate G4s (labels vs re-measured picture; safe frame iff labelled screen/uncertain, by band correlation); the unchanged gate_g4 applied per shot. (2) Phase 3 + 4a: transitions only between different channels over measured non-speech (xfade offset corrected for ffmpeg 4.4.2), G18 word-for-word (edges vs the selection lock + identity vs the source span, canonicalised), the verification pack, telegram.deliver_run captions, the one-command runner. Verify from the diff: (a) no existing gate changed what it accepts (gate_g4, G14, G12/G15, G16/G17 untouched; G4s and G18 are new and only add failures); (b) the frozen v2f render path is untouched when TRANSITIONS.json is absent and layouts are hand overrides (Law 22); (c) transitions never overlap speech, never occur at the open or into the credits, and picture and sound stay frame-locked; (d) the safe frame appears only for screen/uncertain shots and is always named in the 9:16 caption; (e) the caption says HOLD FOR APPROVAL only when every row of both formats is PASS and the pack is complete, the only send path is the approval chat, and credentials are never printed; (f) the runner holds a lock, logs, and never touches other tmux sessions; (g) tests are meaningful, not vacuous. Only state what you can verify from the diff; if uncertain, say so. (this chunk: pipeline/transition_options.py)

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""pipeline/transition_options.py — the labelled transition options on one finished cut (Phase 3, DEC-4).
+
+The production run renders the DEC-4 default (6-frame cross-dissolve + matching audio crossfade). For PBX's
+choice, the SAME cut (same cuts, same prepared clips, same layout plan) is rendered again per option in a
+copy of the run dir, and every option is gated and packed like a production render:
+  A  clean cut; 6-frame audio dip-crossfade across the cut
+  B  6-frame cross-dissolve + matching audio crossfade + a soft synthesized pulse thump
+  C  brand ECG line sweep, 8 frames on black, double thump (no logo, no text, nothing at the open)
+Usage: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 python3 transition_options.py RUN_DIR [A B C]
+Delivery is separate: telegram.deliver_run(<copy>, option="A") (labelled, never a release candidate).
+"""
+import json
+import os
+import shutil
+import sys
+
+PIPELINE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
+sys.path.insert(0, PIPELINE)
+
+
+def render_option(run_dir, style):
+    import run_fresh as rf
+    import verify_pack
+    dst = f"{run_dir.rstrip('/')}_option{style}"
+    if os.path.exists(dst):
+        raise SystemExit(f"STOP: {dst} exists")
+    shutil.copytree(run_dir, dst, ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("TELEGRAM_DELIVERY*.json", "VERIFY"))
+    for p in ("out/segment.mp4", "out/segment_vertical.mp4", "GATE_REPORT.json"):
+        if os.path.exists(os.path.join(dst, p)):
+            os.remove(os.path.join(dst, p))
+    run = rf.Run(dst)
+    with open(os.path.join(dst, "status.json")) as f:
+        run.mode = json.load(f).get("mode", "auto")
+    pin = os.path.join(dst, "PINNED_DECISION.json")
+    if run.mode == "pinned" and os.path.exists(pin):        # same limiter as the original render
+        with open(pin) as f:
+            run.machine_cuts = bool(json.load(f).get("pin", {}).get("machine_cuts", False))
+    with open(os.path.join(dst, "cuts_final.json")) as f:
+        cuts = json.load(f)
+    rf.TRANSITION_STYLE = style                     # the option, on the same cut
+    final16, man16, final9, man9 = rf.stage_render(run)
+    rows, flags, limits = rf.stage_gates(run, final16, man16, final9, man9)
+    verify_pack.build(dst)
+    run.save()
+    print(f"option {style}: {dst} | " + ", ".join(f"{fmt}: {rf.verdict_for(rows[fmt])[0]}" for fmt in rows))
+    return dst, cuts
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    rd = os.path.abspath(sys.argv[1])
+    for st in (sys.argv[2:] or ["A", "B", "C"]):
+        render_option(rd, st)
